name: Colchagua Valley
shape: Chile Decreto 464, drawn from its comunas and provinces

notes: Colchagua is best known for full bodied Malbec, Cabernet Sauvignon, Carmenère and Syrah.
Its warmth ripens grapes fully, giving rich fruit that can seem sweet.

blurb.text: A zone of the Rapel Valley, in Chile's Central Valley, the main growing zone for Chilean wine.
